settings.q: Can you build a model of our specific facility?
settings.a: Yes. Send your site and building drawings and we'll reproduce the facility to scale, with labelled buildings.

settings.q: Can it include lighting and interior detail?
settings.a: Yes - LED lighting, lit interiors and labelled zones are all available.

settings.q: Does it come with a protective case?
settings.a: A clear case and presentation base is included by default to protect your model.
Yes, we ship worldwide from Dubai, crated to protect the model.

settings.hero_desc: A fully detailed scale model of an electroplating and galvanizing factory - named buildings, process lines, landscaping and LED-lit interiors, all to scale on a presentation base. The ultimate way to explain a whole industrial facility to investors and visitors.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your facility layout, building labels, branding and LED lighting
settings.s1_body: This model lays out a complete industrial facility in miniature - the electroplating plant, effluent treatment plant and hot-dip galvanizing plant, each clearly labelled, with process lines, walkways, landscaping and LED-lit interiors. Built to scale from your drawings, it lets clients, investors and visitors understand your whole operation at a glance. A commanding centrepiece for boardrooms, exhibitions and reception areas.
settings.case_heading: A Facility Tour Without Leaving the Room
settings.case_body: Commissioned for Evess, a Russian electroplating company participating in the WETEX exhibition. This model let the team walk stakeholders through the entire plant - building by building, process by process - in a single, tangible centrepiece that no slide deck could match.
settings.case_quote: We can explain our entire operation in minutes now. It's the highlight of our WETEX Exhibition.
settings.prov_p: A complex facility is hard to picture from drawings. A detailed, labelled scale model turns that complexity into a clear, confidence-building story for clients and investors.
